Pick the best fits across seeds

select_best_fits.Rd

Takes the best fit per seed x loss (excluding the round_00 starting points), simulates every candidate, evaluates it on every loss function, and scores it as the sum over loss functions of (loss / best loss across all candidates). Lower is better; the minimum possible score is the number of loss functions.

Usage

select_best_fits(seq_fits, samodel, xt, tswitch, nyears, use_switch = TRUE)

Arguments

seq_fits

List of results from run_sequential_fits(), one per seed.

samodel

The model structure, e.g. from build_samodel().

xt

Grouped x(t) to fit to.

tswitch

Time of the vaccine switch.

nyears

Number of (final) years to fit.

use_switch

Use the vaccine switch.

Value

A list with all_parameters and all_summary (all fits of all seeds), all_best (best fit per seed x loss, with key and score) and overall_best (the one row with the lowest score).
